def test_temp_lag_1_leakage_assertion():
    """Assert temp_lag_1's value on 2011-01-10 equals the prior day's temp."""
    # 2011-01-10 is row index 9 (starting from the reindexed calendar start)
    row = 9  # 2011-01-03 + 7 days = 2011-01-10
    assert "dteday" in feats.columns
    date = feats.dteday.iloc[row]
    expected_temp = -1.498349
    actual_temp = feats["temp"].iloc[row]
    # The lagged temperature on d should equal the prior day's observed temp
    assert pytest.approx(actual_temp, rel=1e-5) == expected_temp
